title: [BOUNTY] wRTC Price Ticker Bot — Discord/Telegram Price Alerts (20 RTC)
body:
## wRTC Price Ticker Bot — 20 RTC Bounty

Build a simple bot that posts the current wRTC/SOL price from Raydium to Discord or Telegram. New token = people want to check the price constantly.

### Price Data Source

wRTC trades on Raydium (Solana DEX). Get price data from:

\`\`\`bash
# Raydium pool info (pool ID: 8CF2Q8nSCxRacDShbtF86XTSrYjueBMKmfdR3MLdnYzb)
# Use Birdeye, DexScreener, or Jupiter API for price

# DexScreener API (free, no key):
curl -s "https://api.dexscreener.com/latest/dex/tokens/12TAdKXxcGf6oCv4rqDz2NkgxjyHq6HQKoxKZYGf5i4X"

# Jupiter price API (free):
curl -s "https://api.jup.ag/price/v2?ids=12TAdKXxcGf6oCv4rqDz2NkgxjyHq6HQKoxKZYGf5i4X"
\`\`\`

### What The Bot Does

- Posts price update on command (\`/price\` or \`!price\`)
- Shows: price in SOL, price in USD, 24h change %, liquidity
- Optional: auto-post every hour to a #price channel
- Optional: alert when price moves >10% in 1 hour

### Implementation

Pick one (or both for extra credit):
- **Discord bot** using discord.py
- **Telegram bot** using python-telegram-bot

### Payout

| Deliverable | RTC |
|-------------|-----|
| Working bot with \`/price\` command showing live wRTC price | 12 |
| Auto-posting + price alerts + clean formatting | 8 |
